updates.title: v1.2.0 - New UI & Extended Hepburn!
updates.body:
・Modernized the main app UI and added an Updates tab.
・Improved App Group fetching logic so settings sync properly even on free SideStore/AltStore environments!
・Massively expanded Romaji conversion patterns (qa→くぁ, va→ゔぁ, etc.)
・Redesigned keyboard UI using SF Symbols for a native iOS feel.
・Added uppercase toggle (a/A) functionality for flick alphabet input.

updates.title: v1.1.0 - QWERTY Long-Press Support
updates.body:
・Added support for special character input by long-pressing keys on the QWERTY keyboard.
・Added toggles in the settings app to show/hide specific keyboard modes.
